subject: Staggered take-home assignment, cohort selection & reviewer rotation
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Li <amanda.li@smallbatch.ai>, talent@smallbatch.ai
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Take-home packet + staggered deadlines (please confirm cohort)

Hi Amanda — thanks again for interviewing with Redwood Inference. Attached is the take-home packet (takehome-instructions.pdf). To make scheduling and reviewer load predictable we’re running this take-home on a staggered/cohort basis this round — please reply to confirm which cohort you prefer:

- Cohort A — deadline: Tue Jun 23 11:59pm PT (quicker turnaround)
- Cohort B — deadline: Thu Jun 25 11:59pm PT (recommended if you need an extra day)
- Cohort C — deadline: Mon Jun 29 11:59pm PT (limited; use only if you absolutely need it)

A few implementation notes (short):
- Deliverables: single ZIP with code, README, sample outputs. Name: lastname_firstname_redwood.zip.
- Allowed: open-source libraries; please list direct ML/infra deps in requirements.txt.
- Environment: we provide a small staging dataset and a link to a read-only S3 (details in the packet).
- Submission: upload link (see submission-upload-link.txt) or reply with the attachment if upload issues.
- Extension policy: one automatic 24-hour extension available on request; request before your cohort deadline.

We’ll assign two reviewers per submission in a rotating schedule and aim to give feedback within 72 hours of submission. Reviewer rubric is here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1TakehomeRubric (also attached).

Please confirm receipt and let me know which cohort you’d like. If you have any questions about the packet or infra, ping me directly.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Recruiting Manager, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
(Attachment: takehome-instructions.pdf)

Subject: Internal: reviewer rotation for Amanda Li (Cohort B) — please confirm availability

Internal only —

Amanda Li (SmallBatch) has chosen Cohort B (deadline Thu Jun 25 11:59pm PT). Please see the plan below and confirm who will take which pass:

Plan / asks:
- Two-reviewer + tie-break flow. First pass = code correctness + infra reproducibility. Second pass = qualitative writeup, clarity, and production considerations. Tie-breaker = third reviewer if scores diverge by >= 2 points.
- Attach score sheet: reviewer-score-sheet.csv. Use rubric link for guidance.
- Proposed rota for submissions that land on Jun 25:
   * First pass: Jonas (complete by Jun 26 3pm PT)
   * Second pass: Marissa (complete by Jun 27 12pm PT)
   * Tie-break: Soojin on standby (available Jun 27 afternoon)

Please confirm you can take these windows or suggest alternatives by EOD today so I can communicate back to the candidate. Also flag any infra access needs — we can spin an ephemeral staging environment if the candidate needs to demo against a live endpoint.

Thanks —
Neha
(Attachment: reviewer-score-sheet.csv)

- If the candidate asks for ephemeral staging access, I can provision read-only S3 creds and a small CPU instance for evaluation; please have them request it at least 6 hours before cutoff so we can spin it up.

Subject: Confirmed: Cohort B + reviewer schedule + submission instructions

Hi Amanda — confirming you’re in Cohort B (Thu Jun 25 11:59pm PT). Per our internal plan the review flow will be: first pass (Jonas) by Jun 26 afternoon, second pass (Marissa) by Jun 27 midday, Soojin standing by for tie-break if needed.

Submission checklist (short):
- ZIP named: Li_Amanda_Redwood.zip
- Include README with run instructions and exact command-line used to reproduce the sample output.
- Note any external deps in requirements.txt (MIT-licensed dependency is fine; please declare it).
- Upload via the secure link (submission-upload-link.txt) or reply to this thread with the attachment if upload fails.

If you need ephemeral staging creds, reply and let us know (Jonas can provision within a few hours if requested before the deadline).

Good luck and please reach out with any hiccups. We’ll follow up with reviewer feedback within ~72 hours of your submission.

Thanks —
